افتحلتن (form VIII)
# اِفْتَحَلْتُنَّ (iftaḥaltunna) /if.ta.ħal.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past active of اِفْتَحَلَ (iftaḥala)
# اُفْتُحِلْتُنَّ (uftuḥiltunna) /uf.tu.ħil.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past passive of اِفْتَحَلَ (iftaḥala)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
